chloe: Heads-up: planning to enable v3.2-catalog in US/EU during tomorrow's 03:00-05:00 UTC window. Need final sign-off on pinned exclusions, fallback order, and rollback gates.
ryan: +1. What's the proposed ramp?
chloe: Thinking micro-ramp: 1% 10m -> 8% 15m -> 25% 20m -> hold 30m. Exclude pinned routes (customer-critical, realtime-low-latency) from hedge.
priya: Fallback ladder we want: prod-stable -> quant-v2 -> mem-slim-fallthrough. Ensure quant-v2 has evict-safe profile.
omar: Ops: drain old variant for 15m after cutover. Hard rollback if p95 increases >35% for 10m OR 5xx spike >0.4% for 5m. Soft pause at p95 +12%.
deploybot: preflight run: 
```
checks: [catalog-config-sane, artifacts-present, telemetry-hooked, runtime-compat]
result: catalog-config-sane:ok, artifacts-present:ok, telemetry-hooked:warning (no eval-smoke in eu), runtime-compat:ok
```
deploybot: telemetry warning must be either fixed or acknowledged. Proceeding without eval-smoke increases risk of undetected regressions.
priya: Product can drop a 30-sample smoke set by EOD. If not, enable synthetic-smoke and stricter alerts.
ochloe: Release notes draft: "Enable v3.2-catalog (phased traffic hedge) in US/EU. Pinned routes excluded. Expected latency variance on quant path; monitor telemetry. Rollback thresholds defined in runbook"
ryan: Also call out expected cost change: ~+8% on quant path in EU.
ops-oncall: I'll be on-call. Recommend adding an automatic regional failover: if eu p95 breaches threshold, route new allocation to us until resolved.
chloe: Good call. Add that to runbook.
priya: Telemetry: I can wire a lightweight eval job that posts to #model-telemetry every 5m during the window. Will set a strict regression flag.
omar: Confirm pin semantics: pinned routes are removed from the hedge and keep previous model pinned at 100% until manually unpinned.
chloe: Final question: any objections to enabling with acknowledged telemetry warning?
ryan: infra approves, acknowledge telemetry risk.
priya: product approves, will deliver smoke set; acknowledge risk if delayed.
omar: ops approves. I'll have rollback procedures ready.
deploybot: approval requested: set `enable=true` for v3.2-catalog scope=[us,eu] schedule=1764543600 (03:00 UTC tomorrow). Please acknowledge telemetry warning if you accept risk.
chloe: Approved and acknowledged. I'll post runbook + release note and ping #releases 20m before start. :rocket:
